summary.text: Zachary Werhan is the Republican candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 83 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A mental health and addiction counselor in Wichita, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include health care costs, property tax relief and addiction treatment.

paragraphs.text: Zachary Werhan earned a high school diploma from Trinity Academy, a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 2015 and a graduate degree from Wichita State University in 2020.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a mental health counselor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a fifth-generation Kansan who runs a counseling practice in Wichita and lives in the Crown Heights neighborhood with his wife and two daughters.
Werhan said in the survey that he would work toward fair Medicaid reimbursement for providers, less red tape and rooting out waste.
He also said he supports a cap on local spending growth tied to inflation together with raising the state's share of the school levy exemption.
